quotes.author: Tucker Williams
quotes.text: Cannot recommend this charter company enough!!! I took my company for a cruise as part of our retreat. Jack was a fantastic captain, with a wealth of knowledge about the Lake and its history. This cruise gave me a whole new appreciation for Lake Tahoe. The 3 hour tour is the way to go. And jumping into the lake for a Polar Plunge at the end was a thrill!

quotes.author: Kristie Santos
quotes.text: Sunnyside Marina never disappoints! We’ve rented boats from them for several years - the boats are well maintained, clean, and in good shape! Their staff are also excellent…. They explain everything, are helpful with areas to avoid and updated in the weather. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Jason Harrington
quotes.text: What a great time we had on the pontoon ride. We had Miles as our captain and he did an amazing job. We were enjoying Lake Tahoe for a quick visit and we are so glad we took the opportunity to tour the lake by boat. THANK YOU!!

quotes.author: Kelly Powell
quotes.text: JC was an excellent captain. He had ideas of where to go, but also engaged in our suggestions. Great vibe. 10/10

quotes.author: Angus Sullivan
quotes.text: We had a great day out on Lake Tahoe. Olivia was super helpful would come back and rent again any time.

quotes.author: joe zurek
quotes.text: Myles our captain was the man!! Great experience across the board.
